Manotu\'s own code is open source (MIT). It is built from these open-source components:

Manotu only has your approximate location (about 1–3 km), so your arrow can sit on the wrong road and turns come at the wrong time. Allow precise location to navigate. Your location stays on your phone; while navigating only anonymous speed points are shared.
Approximate location only: directions may be wrong
Components that are not open source
Manotu uses three Google services on Android. None of them receives your favourites, places or trips.
Google Play services location: turns GPS, Wi-Fi and mobile signals into your position on the phone, for the map and navigation.
Google sign-in and Drive authorisation: only when you choose Google Drive backup. Drive receives only the backup YOU send to your own Drive.
Play Integrity: when you confirm a nearby place, checks the vote comes from a real phone. Only a pass/fail verdict reaches Manotu.
